0:
until nc -z lldap.auth.svc.cluster.local 3890; do
  echo "waiting for lldap:3890..."; sleep 3
done
echo "lldap reachable"

[general]
timezone: America/Toronto

[printer fdm01]
moonraker_uri: ws://192.168.42.25:7125/websocket
moonraker_api_key: False

[printer fdm02]
moonraker_uri: ws://192.168.42.26:7125/websocket
moonraker_api_key: False

api: yes
apiAddress: :9997
authInternalUsers:
  - user: any
    permissions:
      - action: publish
      - action: read
      - action: playback
      - action: api
rtsp: yes
rtspAddress: :8554
rtmp: yes
rtmpAddress: :1935
hls: yes
hlsAddress: :8888
hlsVariant: fmp4
hlsSegmentCount: 3
hlsSegmentDuration: 1s
webrtc: no
srt: no
paths:
  all_others:
mkdir -p /data/db /data/files /data/thumbs /data/staging /data/backups && uv run alembic upgrade head && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --no-access-log --proxy-headers

# remap app name from label
.custom_app_name = .pod_labels."app.kubernetes.io/name" || .pod_labels.app || .pod_labels."k8s-app" || "unknown"
# remap pod name from event
.custom_pod_name = .pod_name || "unknown"
# drop remapped fields
del(.pod_labels)
